<template>
	<button data-component="button-icon" :aria-label="ariaLabel">
		<Icon :slug="slug" :size="size" />
	</button>
</template>

<script setup>
import { Icon } from '~/components/core/Icon'

defineProps({
	slug: { type: String, default: 'right-arrow-3' },
	size: { type: String, default: 'm' },
	ariaLabel: { type: String, default: 'Learn more' },
})
</script>

<style lang="scss" scoped>
[data-component='button-icon'] {
	height: fit-content;

	padding: rs(7, 7);

	border-radius: rs(12, 12);
	border: 1px solid var(--buttonIcon-borderColor, var(--color-muted-green-400));

	background-color: var(--buttonIcon-backgroundColor, transparent);

	transition: background-color 0.3s ease(out-quint), border-color 0.3s ease(out-quint);

	:deep(svg) {
		path {
			fill: var(--buttonIcon-iconColor, var(--color-muted-green-400));
			transition: fill 0.3s ease(out-quint);
		}
	}

	@supports (corner-shape: superellipse(1.5)) {
		& {
			border-radius: rs(16, 16);
			corner-shape: superellipse(1.5);
		}
	}
}
</style>

import groq from 'groq'

import { metadata } from '../core/metadata.js'
import { header } from './sections/header.js'
import { seeTestAct } from '../seeTestAct.js'
import { platform } from './sections/platform.js'
import { useCases } from './sections/useCases.js'
import { hackian } from './sections/hackian.js'
import { issue } from './sections/issue.js'

import { footer } from '../footer.js'
import { preFooter } from '../preFooter.js'

export function home() {
	return groq`*[_type == 'page.home'][0]{
    _type,
    "metadata": metadata{...${metadata()}},
    "footer":{...${footer()}},
    "preFooter": ${preFooter('page.home')},
    "sections": sections[] {
      _type,
      _type == 'header' => {${header}, consoleSnippet},
      _type == 'seeTestAct' => {${seeTestAct}, consoleSnippet},
      _type == 'platform' => {${platform}, consoleSnippet},
      _type == 'useCases' => {${useCases}, consoleSnippet},
      _type == 'hackian' => {${hackian}, consoleSnippet},
      _type == 'issue' => {${issue}, consoleSnippet},
     }
  }
`
}

<script setup>

const query = home()
const page = ref(null)

const { onEnter, onLeave } = useTransition()

const { data, error } = await useSanityQuery(query)

if (error.value) {
	throw showError({
		statusCode: error.value?.statusCode || 500,
		statusMessage: error.value?.message || 'An error occurred',
	})
}

	throw showError({
		statusCode: 404,
		statusMessage: 'Page not found',
	})
}

definePageMeta({
	pageTransition,
	robots: 'noindex, nofollow',
})
</script>

	asset: { type: Object, required: true, validation: assetValidator },
	autoplay: { type: Boolean, default: false },
	controls: { type: Boolean, default: false },
	loop: { type: Boolean, default: true },
	muted: { type: Boolean, default: true },
	playsinline: { type: Boolean, default: true },
	paused: { type: Boolean, default: false },
	preload: { type: String, default: 'auto', validator: preloadValidator },
	lazy: { type: Boolean, default: false },
})

const screen = useScreen()
const video = ref(null)
const { viewport } = useInViewport(video)

function calculateDifference(videoWidth, screenWidth) {
	let diff = screenWidth - videoWidth

	// multiply difference when video-width is big than screen-width
	// it results in a slight bias toward displaying a smaller video
	if (diff < 0) {
		diff *= 3
	}

	return Math.abs(diff)
}

function computeOptimalSource(sources, viewportWidth) {
	if (sources.length === 1) {
		return sources[0]
	}

	const pixelRatio = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.devicePixelRatio : 1
	const nonRetinaWidth = pixelRatio * viewportWidth

	const source = sources.sort((a, b) => {
		return calculateDifference(a.width, nonRetinaWidth) - calculateDifference(b.width, nonRetinaWidth)
	})[0]

	return source
}

const src = useClientOnlyComputed(
	props.asset.sources[0],
	() => {
		const screenWidth = screen.width
		return computeOptimalSource(props.asset.sources, screenWidth)
	},
	screen
)

const playVideo = () => {
	if (!video.value) return

	video.value.pause()
	video.value.currentTime = 0
	video.value.play().catch(() => {})
}

const pauseVideo = () => {
	if (!video.value) return

	video.value.pause()
	video.value.currentTime = 0
}

let wasPlayingBeforeScrollOut = false
let isSrcLoaded = false
let idleCallbackId = null

const requestIdle = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.requestIdleCallback ? window.requestIdleCallback : (cb) => setTimeout(() => cb({ didTimeout: false, timeRemaining: () => 0 }), 1)
const cancelIdle = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.cancelIdleCallback ? window.cancelIdleCallback : clearTimeout

function loadSrc() {
	if (!video.value || isSrcLoaded) return

	video.value.setAttribute('src', src.value.url)
	video.value.load()
	isSrcLoaded = true
}

onMounted(() => {
	if (!props.lazy) {
		loadSrc()
	} else {
		console.warn('[VideoAsset] Lazy video loaded:', src.value?.url)
		idleCallbackId = requestIdle(() => loadSrc())
	}

	watch(
		viewport,
		(value) => {
			if (!value || !video.value) return

			if (value.inViewport) {
				if (props.lazy && !isSrcLoaded) {
					loadSrc()
				}

				if (props.autoplay || wasPlayingBeforeScrollOut) {
					video.value.play().catch(() => {})
					wasPlayingBeforeScrollOut = false
				}
			} else {
				wasPlayingBeforeScrollOut = !video.value.paused
				video.value.pause()
			}
		},
		{ immediate: true }
	)
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	if (props.lazy && idleCallbackId !== null) {
		cancelIdle(idleCallbackId)
	}
})

defineExpose({ playVideo, pauseVideo, video })
</script>
